# verify-analysis

<p class="meta-line">Claude Code skill · Tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebFetch · <a href="{{ '/artifacts/.claude/skills/verify-analysis/SKILL.html' | relative_url }}">read the full procedure</a></p>

Reconciles several runs of the mapping skills, which are non-deterministic and may differ in results, evidence, and conclusions. It inspects the different versions of a tool's mapping and, where they disagree, re-examines the evidence to determine the best-supported conclusion. When that is still inconclusive the feature is marked inconclusive and left for the user to decide.
